program.name: Kick Circuit
program.subject: Kickboxing
program.blurb: Kickboxing bouts, then a circuit of kicks, knees and leg strength.
program.about: Kickboxing bouts, then a circuit for the legs and hips behind every kick: knees, squats, lunges and core. Two versions alternate. Strong, mobile hips make kicks higher and harder. Abs finish every session. Level II brings longer combinations and Level III adds reps.
